description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DatabaseTransactions' within the SuiteCRM namespace. It provides methods to start and rollback database transactions using a factory to obtain the database manager instance.

methods.name: startDBTransaction
methods.description: Begins a database transaction by executing 'START TRANSACTION' via the DB manager.

methods.name: rollbackDBTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back a database transaction by executing 'ROLLBACK' via the DB manager.
